brief_title: Extension to a Study on the Efficacy and Safety of Vildagliptin in Combination With Glimepiride in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Extension to a Study on the Efficacy and Safety of Vildagliptin in Combination With Glimepiride in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: Safety of vildagliptin in combination with glimepiride during 52 weeks of treatment
Change from baseline in HbA1c at 52 weeks

brief_summary: Many people with type 2 diabetes cannot maintain target blood glucose levels when taking a single oral drug. This is a 28-week extension to a study to assess the safety and effectiveness of vildagliptin, an unapproved drug, in lowering overall blood glucose levels when added to glimepiride in people with type 2 diabetes not at target blood glucose levels on a sulfonylurea alone. The purpose of the extension study is to gather data on the long-term safety and effectiveness of vildagliptin in people with type 2 diabetes.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Only patients successfully completing study CLAF237A2305 are eligible
* Written informed consent
* Ability to comply with all study requirements

Exclusion Criteria:

* Premature discontinuation from study CLAF237A2305
* Other protocol-defined exclusion criteria may apply
